title: Confirmed fees 2026 to 2027: Extended producer responsibility for packaging - GOV.UK

triage.reason: GOV.UK published the confirmed 2026 to 2027 packaging waste disposal fees charged to large producers obligated under UK packaging EPR, a concrete fee-setting update dated today.

draft.summary: This guidance sets out the 2026 to 2027 packaging waste disposal fees charged to large producers obligated under extended producer responsibility for packaging who supply or import packaging in the UK. The page, published on 16 December 2025 by PackUK and the Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs, was updated on 25 November 2026 to the confirmed 2026 to 2027 packaging waste disposal fees.
draft.source_quote:
Under EPR for packaging, obligated large producers who supply or import packaging in the UK are responsible for the costs of dealing with packaging waste.
This guidance sets out the 2026 to 2027 packaging waste disposal fees.
draft.interpretation: Confirmed disposal fee levels for 2026 to 2027 give obligated producers and their packaging suppliers a fixed cost signal for the year, which will feed into packaging-data and fee-modulation decisions ahead of reporting.
